## Description

Favors firms with conservative asset growth or investment and underweights firms expanding assets aggressively, typically within a multi-factor framework.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon cross-sectional equity selection; may complement value, quality and momentum signals.

## Vehicles

Equity factor and multi-factor funds, long-only or market-neutral mandates.

## Required data

Point-in-time balance sheets/cash-flow statements, asset growth, firm size, prices and sector classifications.

## Caveats

Accounting timing, accrual classification and sector effects must be controlled; low turnover does not remove factor drawdown risk.
